data.name: Party Time Bowling
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO PARTY TIME BOWLING

The lights are glowing, the lanes are polished, and the party is already in progress.

Party Time Bowling is a colorful multiplayer party game set inside a neon-lit bowling alley packed with collectible balls, arcade attractions, and plenty of ways to play your way.

Grab your friends, pick a game, and see who becomes the life of the alley.

PARTY UP - UP TO 8 PLAYERS

Host or join a lobby and fill the alley with friends.

  • Jump into lobbies with up to 8 players

  • Play together across the alley's party modes

  • Swap between attractions without losing the vibe

  • Compete, clown around, and chase high scores as a group

Whether it's a packed lobby or a quick session with a few friends, the alley stays lively.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY

The bowling alley isn't just one game - it's a whole night out.

Bowling

Line up your shot, control your roll, and send the ball racing toward the pins. Chase strikes, spares, and those "how did that happen?" moments.

Roll Ball

Step up to the glowing Roll Ball machines, launch the ball up the ramp, and aim for the highest-scoring targets. Precision, timing, and just a little chaos.

Air Hockey

Slide over to the table, smash the puck, and battle for the win in fast arcade showdowns.

  • Bowl across atmospheric neon-lit lanes

  • Climb the Roll Ball scoreboard

  • Clash in Air Hockey

  • Jump between party modes whenever the mood strikes

BUILD YOUR BALL COLLECTION

Why settle for one ordinary bowling ball?

Visit the Alley Store and dig through 100+ unlockable ball skins - clean classics, bright neon, wild patterns, fiery finishes, cosmic looks, novelty balls, and more.

  • Unlock 100+ distinctive ball skins

  • Equip the design that matches your personality

  • Show off a new look every time you hit the lanes

  • Keep earning and expanding your collection

Your ball may not guarantee a strike - but it can look incredible on the way to the gutter.

EARN ALLEY BUCKS

Play activities around the alley and earn Alley Bucks, the local cash used to grow your ball collection.

Save up for something special, grab an affordable new favorite, or work toward filling every shelf in the store.

A BOWLING ALLEY WITH PERSONALITY

Explore an atmospheric entertainment center inspired by classic bowling alleys and arcades, complete with:

  • Purple and pink neon lighting

  • Retro patterned carpeting

  • Arcade-style side attractions

  • A dedicated Alley Store

  • Shelves packed with collectible bowling balls

  • Party modes built for groups of friends

Pick a ball. Find your friends. Light up the lanes. Up to 8 players. 100+ skins. Endless fun. It's always Party Time at the bowling alley.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-8350 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 2GB / AMD RX 560 4GB / Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 / RTX 3050 / RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS 64-bit (or equivalent)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.1 capable: GTX 1050 / RX 560 / Arc A380
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.x
  • Processor: AMD APU (Steam Deck LCD / OLED class)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RDNA2 iGPU (Deck) @ 30 FPS targets with lowered settings
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
